proof_spans.label: Complete original fan/shuffle andthree tree-model realization developments,including allsource-specificproofbranches

core_obligations: With ordinary permutahedron/associahedron normal fans and the standard Cartesian-product/Minkowski-sum fan rules given, the remaining realization problem is to obtain exactly the prescribed painted-tree,cotree andoppositely-growing bitree deletion face posets. The author construction chooses the complete-bipartite graphical-zonotope correction, organizes allmixed facepreorders and reconstructs the underlying tree/cut/block data so that refinement corresponds to the target deletions in everyface dimension. This geometric-to-combinatorial model identification,including the reflected associahedron required by bitrees,is the one H2 constructioncore; convexity or closure under Minkowski sum alone does not supply the targetface-poset isomorphisms. Count the complete unified Proposition0.2 with all source-specific definitions and maps,not16helper statements or one count perfamily. Elementary rank arithmetic,the explicit painted-poset join formula,and Schröder substitutions/counting formulas are supporting steps,not independent difficulty claims. Authors reader-checks are preserved at printedgranularity without supplemental mathematics.
